page.layout: One printed page, top to bottom: running head at top with page number at upper right; a full-width text block of running paragraph; a centred heading with subheading; then a list of names in two columns (left column with names, right column beginning with Bilmarus and Boleslaus), continuing in the left column below. Visible part ends mid-list at the scan edge.; One block of text in the right part of the page: a list of names in lines, with centred and italic headings; the left part is blanked out. Lines at the foot of the page continue to the left edge.

main_text.p: tuba dari jubeant; quo audito depugnantes omissis clavis suis, gladiis rem gerere incipiant, & alia aliorum clenodiaconscindere & diloricare contendant. quo facto septa recluduntur, utpote rite omnibus, quae ad ludorum solemnia pertinent, administratis. Statutum in Maidenburgo, die Sabbathi post Octavam Trium Regum, Anno Dominicae Incarnationis MDCCCXXXVIII. in praesentia omnium Procerum & Optimatum Imperii ex Germania, Gallia & Sclavorum gentibus convocatorum, quorum haec sunt nomina juxta distributionem exercituum, quos Imperator contra hostes Imperii ordinaverat ad ejus magnitudinem conservandam & augmentandam:
